errors: 'Net investment income increased 19.9% quarter-over-quarter': Petrucelli said it increased 19.9% 'in the second quarter over last year' (year-over-year).

New mention 'Homeowners line': homeowners was discussed in Q1 (E&S Homeowners down 22%).
